snapshot.description: Custom BM25 with field-weighted scoring, code-aware two-pass tokenizer, score normalization + stable sort + zero-result guard, topic-aware graph.neighbors scoring, token budget allocator with structural truncation. ONNX Embedder trait + OnnxEmbedder (ort, bge-small), NoopEmbedder fallback, vector storage (SQLite + ArcSwap), SearchMode enum, RRF fusion, index.rebuild with ArcSwap, staleness detection
snapshot.title: BM25 + Search + ONNX Embeddings
